site.name: Help Lagbe?
site.identity: Human to Human. People for People.
site.secular: A secular service. No religious preference, no religious test, no discrimination. Human dignity regardless of belief, gender, class, disability or background.
site.no_dispatch: Help Lagbe? does not dispatch police, ambulances or rescue services. In immediate danger, contact the emergency numbers shown if it is safe to do so.

a11y.quick_exit_help: Leaves this site immediately and opens a neutral page. You can also press Escape three times.

state.offline: You appear to be offline. Pages you have already opened still work; sending anything will wait until you reconnect.
state.offline_text: This page could not be loaded because there is no connection.
state.offline_hint: Reconnect and try again. Nothing you typed into a form has been sent.

error.403_title: You do not have access to this page
error.403_text: This area is restricted on a need-to-know basis. If you believe you should have access, ask your supervisor; access decisions are logged.
error.404_text: The address may be wrong, or the page may have been withdrawn.
error.413_text: Your files exceed the size limit. Reduce the number or size of files and try again. Your report was not sent.
error.429_text: Please wait a few minutes before trying again. This limit protects the service from automated abuse.
error.500_title: Something went wrong on our side
error.500_text: The problem has been recorded without any of your personal details. Please try again in a moment.
error.csrf_text: For your safety, forms expire after a while. Go back, reload the page and submit again.

validation.accept: You need to accept the terms to continue.
validation.consent: Your consent is required to continue.
validation.spam: The form could not be accepted.
validation.mfa_code: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
validation.password_common: This password is too common or too repetitive.
validation.password_contains_email: The password must not contain your email address.
validation.password_contains_name: The password must not contain your name.
validation.password_match: The two passwords do not match.
validation.url: Enter a full address starting with https://

auth.login_lead: For staff accounts and for reporters who chose to create an account. You do not need an account to report or to track a case.
auth.invalid: The email or password is not correct, or the account is temporarily locked.
auth.register_lead: An account is optional. It lets you see a list of the reports you made while signed in. It does not change how your identity is protected.
auth.register_notice: Do not create an account on a shared or monitored device if that could put you at risk. You can always report without one.
auth.name: Name
auth.name_help: Any name you want us to use. It does not have to be your legal name.
auth.password_help: At least 12 characters. Avoid names, dates and common words.
auth.accept_terms: I have read the Privacy and Safeguarding pages and understand how my data is handled.
auth.registered: If this email was not already registered, your account is ready. You can sign in now.
auth.mfa_setup_lead: Staff accounts must use an authenticator app. This protects the people who trust us with their reports.
auth.mfa_step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone (any app that supports time-based codes).
auth.mfa_step2: Scan this code with the app, or enter the key manually.
auth.mfa_step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows now.
auth.mfa_qr_alt: QR code for the authenticator app
auth.mfa_enrol_required: Before you can continue, set up two-step verification.
auth.mfa_already: Two-step verification is already enabled on your account.
auth.mfa_wrong: That code is not valid. Check the time on your phone and try again.
auth.mfa_verify_lead: Open your authenticator app and enter the current 6-digit code.
auth.mfa_too_many: Too many incorrect codes. Please sign in again.
auth.mfa_lost: Lost your authenticator? Ask an administrator to reset two-step verification; the reset is logged.
auth.invalid_current: The current password is not correct.

contacts.public_title: If you are in immediate danger
contacts.public_help: These external services are not run by Help Lagbe?. A number is listed only after a named staff member has verified it.
contacts.none_verified_text: We do not list a number until a staff member has checked it. Contact your local emergency services directly.
contacts.help: External helplines shown on the public site. A contact becomes visible to the public only after it is verified here by a named person.
contacts.unverified: Not verified — hidden from the public
contacts.verification_placeholder: e.g. called on 22 Oct, answered by operator

request.lead: Ask for a correction, a right of reply, an appeal, removal of published content, or make a complaint about this service. Requests are read by a person.
request.type_help: Complaints about a staff member are never handled by that staff member.
request.publication_help: Optional. The last part of the article's web address.
request.case_reference_help: Optional. Only if your request is about a case you reported.
request.contact_help: An email address or phone number, stored encrypted and shown to staff only when they record why they opened it. Leave empty to stay anonymous.
request.submitted_text: Keep this reference. A person will review your request. We cannot promise a timeframe, and we will only reply if you gave us a way to.
request.queue_help: Corrections, replies, appeals, removal requests and complaints from the public. Each decision is logged.
request.resolution_help: Write the decision as you would explain it to the requester.

my_reports.lead: Reports you submitted while signed in. Opening a case still needs its one-time key: we deliberately do not tie the key to your account.
my_reports.none_text: Reports you make while signed in as a confidential reporter will be listed here.
my_reports.note: Staff cannot see this list. Your account email is stored with the case identity, encrypted, and is only opened with a recorded reason.

track.secret_help: Shown once after you submitted. We store only a fingerprint of it, so we cannot resend it.
track.not_found: No case matches that reference and key.
track.lost_key: If you lost the key, we cannot recover it. You can submit a new report and mention the old reference in it.
track.forget_device: Forget this case on this device
track.forget_help: Removes it from this browser. You can open it again with the reference and key.
track.severity_note: A severity level describes urgency and potential harm as assessed by a trained person. It never describes guilt.
track.write_help: Only the people assigned to your case can read this. Do not include your name or phone number unless you want them stored with the case.
track.message_sent: Your message has been added to the case.
track.update_received: Report received. Waiting for human review.

status_help.submitted: Your report has been received and is waiting for a trained person to review it.
status_help.triage: A trained person is reviewing the report, assessing urgency and deciding which team should handle it.
status_help.assigned: The case has been assigned to one or more named staff members.
status_help.under_review: The assigned team is working on the case.
status_help.specialist_review: A specialist (legal, cyber or safeguarding) is reviewing part of the case.
status_help.referral_action: A referral or documented action is in progress, with your consent where it involves you.
status_help.follow_up: The team is following up on a referral or action to confirm what happened.
status_help.resolved: The case has been resolved. You can still write to the team.
status_help.closed: The case is closed. You can appeal or ask for it to be reopened.
status_help.appealed: An appeal is being considered by someone who did not handle the case originally.
status_help.reopened: The case has been reopened and is being reviewed again.

report.page_title: Report wrongdoing or ask for help
report.lead: Take your time. You can stop at any point. Nothing is sent until you press the button at the end.
report.danger_box_title: If you are in immediate danger right now
report.danger_box_text: This form is read by people, not instantly. We do not dispatch emergency services. If it is safe, contact the verified numbers below first.
report.no_verified_contacts: No verified emergency numbers are listed yet.
report.category_help: Choose the closest match; a person will re-route it if needed.
report.title: Short summary
report.title_help: One line, like a headline. No names needed.
report.narrative_help: In your own words, in Bengali or English. What, when, where, who was involved (you can describe people without naming them), and what you would like to happen.
report.approximate_time_placeholder: e.g. last Tuesday evening, or over the past month
report.location_help: An area or type of place is enough. Do not enter a home address.
report.immediate_danger_help: Your answer puts the report at the front of the queue for a safeguarding worker. It does not call anyone.
report.child_involved: A child (under 18) is involved or affected
report.child_involved_help: Child-safety cases follow a stricter protocol and are never published as stories.
report.submission_type: How do you want to report?
report.type_anonymous_desc: We collect no name, phone or email. Staff can only reach you through the Track My Case page.
report.type_confidential_desc: Your details are stored apart from the case, encrypted, and opened only by an assigned worker who records a reason. Restricted, not absolute: a court order or a serious risk to life could require disclosure.
report.identity_notice: Fill in only what you want us to hold. Every time someone opens these details, who, when and why is logged.
report.identity_name: Name you want us to use
report.contact_preference_help: Tracking page is the safest option: nothing leaves this site.
report.do_not_contact: Who must never be contacted about this
report.do_not_contact_help: We never contact family members, employers or the people you report. Write it here anyway so it is on record.
report.safe_contact_notes: Anything else about contacting you safely
report.consent_contact: I agree to be contacted in the way I chose above
report.consent_contact_help: Without this, staff will only write to you on the tracking page.
report.evidence_help: Up to {max} files, {mb} MB in total. Photos, PDF, audio, video or text. Files are stored outside the website, checked, and downloaded only by assigned staff who record a reason.
report.consent_process: I understand how this report will be handled and agree to it being reviewed by Help Lagbe? staff.
report.consent_process_help: Required. Explained on the Privacy and Safeguarding pages.
report.consent_publication: A fully redacted, de-identified version of this may be considered for publication after review.
report.consent_publication_help: Optional. Without it, nothing about this case is ever published. You can withdraw later through the tracking page.
report.submit_note: You will be shown a reference and a one-time key.
report.submitted_lead: Thank you. A trained person will review it. Save the two items below now: they are the only way to follow your case.
report.safety_title: You said someone is in immediate danger
report.safety_text: Your report is flagged for a safeguarding worker. We do not dispatch emergency services. If it is safe, contact these numbers now.
report.keep_safe_text: We store only a fingerprint of the key, so we cannot resend it. If someone else could see your phone or browser, write it down elsewhere.
report.next1: A trained person reviews the report and assigns a severity level with written reasoning.
report.next2: It is routed to the right team, who may write to you on the tracking page.
report.next3: Any referral or publication needs your consent. Every sensitive access is logged.
report.saved_button: I have saved my reference and key
report.saved_note: This removes them from this screen so they are not visible to anyone else using this device.
report.error_consent_required: Consent is required to submit a report.

category.corruption: Suspected corruption or misuse of office

contact.tracking_page: Only through the Track My Case page

upload.error_type: This file type is not allowed, or the file content does not match its name.
upload.error_size: The file is larger than the limit.
upload.error_count: Too many files for one report.

support.closed_explain: Live chat only opens when a trained human agent has set themselves available during staffed hours. We never show a chat as open when nobody is there.
support.service_not_staffed: Live support is not currently staffed.
support.service_disabled: Service marked as not staffed by an administrator
support.topic: What would you like to talk about?
support.consent: I understand this is a private chat with a trained person, it is not an emergency service, and the conversation is kept for safeguarding review.
support.chat_privacy: Only the agent assigned to you and their supervisor can read this. Reference:
support.no_dispatch: This chat is not an emergency service. If you are in immediate danger, use the emergency numbers on the Get Help page if it is safe.
support.left_text: The conversation is closed on your side and removed from this device. If you agreed to a follow-up, the agent will use only the method you chose.
support.msg_waiting: You are in the queue. A trained person will join as soon as one is free.
support.msg_agent_joined: A support agent has joined the conversation.
support.msg_escalated: A supervisor has been asked to join for extra support.
support.error_closed: Live support is closed right now.
support.error_permission: You are not part of this conversation.
support.error_reason: Give a reason of at least 10 characters.
support.error_case: That case is not visible to you.
support.queue_help: Waiting visitors first, safety-flagged conversations at the top. Accepting a conversation marks you busy.
support.presence_help: Visitors only see the chat as open while at least one agent is available and has been seen in the last two minutes. Set yourself offline before you leave.
support.agent_guidance: Listen first. Do not promise outcomes. Do not ask for identifying details unless needed and agreed. If there is risk to life or a child, escalate now. Never contact a family member or the person they describe.
support.escalate_help: Use for risk to life, child safety, threats, or when you need support yourself.
support.escalated: A supervisor has been notified in the queue.
support.follow_up_help: Only with the visitor's clear agreement, and only through a method they chose in the chat. Record what was agreed.
support.follow_up_consent: The visitor agreed to a follow-up
support.link_case_help: If the visitor already has a case reference, link it. To create a case, ask them to use the report form:
support.supervisor_reason_help: You are not part of this conversation. Supervisors can read it for safeguarding review only; your reason is logged with your name.

support_topic.digital: Online safety or a hacked account

awareness.none_text: Awareness material appears here after editorial review.

investigations.none_text: Stories appear here only after consent, review, redaction and approval.
investigations.outcomes_help: Outcomes recorded by a case worker and verified by a second person. No case details are shown.
